NKJV.1: Now Moses, with the elders of Israel, commanded the people, saying: “Keep all the commandments which I command you today.
NKJV.2: And it shall be, on the day when you cross over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God is giving you, that you shall set up for yourselves large stones, and whitewash them with lime.
NKJV.3: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have crossed over, that you may enter the land which the LORD your God is giving you, ‘a land flowing with milk and honey,’ just as the LORD God of your fathers promised you.
NKJV.4: Therefore it shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that on Mount Ebal you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, and you shall whitewash them with lime.
NKJV.5: And there you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones; you shall not use an iron tool on them.
NKJV.6: You shall build with whole stones the altar of the LORD your God, and offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
NKJV.7: You shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before the LORD your God.
NKJV.8: And you shall write very plainly on the stones all the words of this law.”
NKJV.9: Then Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying, “Take heed and listen, O Israel: This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.
NKJV.10: Therefore you shall obey the voice of the LORD your God, and observe His commandments and His statutes which I command you today.”
NKJV.11: And Moses commanded the people on the same day, saying,
NKJV.12: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin;
NKJV.13: and these shall stand on Mount Ebal to curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
NKJV.14: “And the Levites shall speak with a loud voice and say to all the men of Israel:
NKJV.15: ‘Cursed is the one who makes a carved or molded image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ “And all the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.16: ‘Cursed is the one who treats his father or his mother with contempt.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.17: ‘Cursed is the one who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.18: ‘Cursed is the one who makes the blind to wander off the road.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.19: ‘Cursed is the one who perverts the justice due the stranger, the fatherless, and widow.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.20: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with his father’s wife, because he has uncovered his father’s bed.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.21: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with any kind of animal.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.22: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.23: ‘Cursed is the one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.24: ‘Cursed is the one who attacks his neighbor secretly.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.25: ‘Cursed is the one who takes a bribe to slay an innocent person.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’
NKJV.26: ‘Cursed is the one who does not confirm all the words of this law by observing them.’ “And all the people shall say, ‘Amen!’

ESV.1: Now Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep the whole commandment that I command you today.
ESV.2: And on the day you cross over the Jordan to the land that the LORD your God is giving you, you shall set up large stones and plaster them with plaster.
ESV.3: And you shall write on them all the words of this law, when you cross over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
ESV.4: And when you have crossed over the Jordan, you shall set up these stones, concerning which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall plaster them with plaster.
ESV.5: And there you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall wield no iron tool on them;
ESV.6: you shall build an altar to the LORD your God of uncut  stones. And you shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God,
ESV.7: and you shall sacrifice peace offerings and shall eat there, and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God.
ESV.8: And you shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
ESV.9: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, “Keep silence and hear, O Israel: this day you have become the people of the LORD your God.
ESV.10: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God, keeping his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
ESV.11: That day Moses charged the people, saying,
ESV.12: “When you have crossed over the Jordan, these shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
ESV.13: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
ESV.14: And the Levites shall declare to all the men of Israel in a loud voice:
ESV.15: “‘Cursed be the man who makes a carved or cast metal image, an abomination to the LORD, a thing made by the hands of a craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ And all the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.16: “‘Cursed be anyone who dishonors his father or his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.17: “‘Cursed be anyone who moves his neighbor's landmark.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.18: “‘Cursed be anyone who misleads a blind man on the road.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.19: “‘Cursed be anyone who perverts the justice due to the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.20: “‘Cursed be anyone who lies with his father's wife, because he has uncovered his father's nakedness.’  And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.21: “‘Cursed be anyone who lies with any kind of animal.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.22: “‘Cursed be anyone who lies with his sister, whether the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.23: “‘Cursed be anyone who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.24: “‘Cursed be anyone who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.25: “‘Cursed be anyone who takes a bribe to shed innocent blood.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
ESV.26: “‘Cursed be anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

NLT.1: Then Moses and the leaders of Israel gave this charge to the people: “Obey all these commands that I am giving you today.
NLT.2: When you cross the Jordan River and enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.
NLT.3: Write this whole body of instruction on them when you cross the river to enter the land the LORD your God is giving you — a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your ancestors, promised you.
NLT.4: When you cross the Jordan, set up these stones at Mount Ebal and coat them with plaster, as I am commanding you today.
NLT.5: “Then build an altar there to the LORD your God, using natural, uncut stones. You must not shape the stones with an iron tool.
NLT.6: Build the altar of uncut stones, and use it to offer burnt offerings to the LORD your God.
NLT.7: Also sacrifice peace offerings on it, and celebrate by feasting there before the LORD your God.
NLT.8: You must clearly write all these instructions on the stones coated with plaster.”
NLT.9: Then Moses and the Levitical priests addressed all Israel as follows: “O Israel, be quiet and listen! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.
NLT.10: So you must obey the LORD your God by keeping all these commands and decrees that I am giving you today.”
NLT.11: That same day Moses also gave this charge to the people:
NLT.12: “When you cross the Jordan River, the tribes of Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin must stand on Mount Gerizim to proclaim a blessing over the people.
NLT.13: And the tribes of Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali must stand on Mount Ebal to proclaim a curse.
NLT.14: “Then the Levites will shout to all the people of Israel:
NLT.15: ‘Cursed is anyone who carves or casts an idol and secretly sets it up. These idols, the work of craftsmen, are detestable to the LORD.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.16: ‘Cursed is anyone who dishonors father or mother.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.17: ‘Cursed is anyone who steals property from a neighbor by moving a boundary marker.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.18: ‘Cursed is anyone who leads a blind person astray on the road.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.19: ‘Cursed is anyone who denies justice to foreigners, orphans, or widows.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.20: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with one of his father’s wives, for he has violated his father.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.21: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with an animal.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.22: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with his sister, whether she is the daughter of his father or his mother.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.23: ‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.24: ‘Cursed is anyone who attacks a neighbor in secret.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.25: ‘Cursed is anyone who accepts payment to kill an innocent person.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’
NLT.26: ‘Cursed is anyone who does not affirm and obey the terms of these instructions.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen.’

CSB17.1: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, “Keep every command I am giving you today.
CSB17.2: When you cross the Jordan into the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and cover them with plaster. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.3: Write all the words of this law on the stones after you cross to enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, <sup>ⓐ</sup> as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
CSB17.4: When you have crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you are to cover them with plaster.
CSB17.5: Build an altar of stones there to the LORD your God — do not use any iron tool on them. <sup>ⓑ</sup>
CSB17.6: Use uncut stones to build the altar of the LORD your God and offer burnt offerings to the LORD your God on it.
CSB17.7: There you are to sacrifice fellowship offerings, eat, and rejoice in the presence of the LORD your God.
CSB17.8: Write clearly all the words of this law on the plastered stones.”
CSB17.9: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, “Be silent, Israel, and listen! This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.
CSB17.10: Obey the LORD your God and follow his commands and statutes I am giving you today.”
CSB17.11: On that day Moses commanded the people,
CSB17.12: “When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes will stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
CSB17.13: And these tribes will stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.14: The Levites will proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite:
CSB17.15: ‘The person who makes a carved idol or cast image, which is detestable to the LORD, the work of a craftsman, and sets it up in secret is cursed.’ And all the people will reply, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.16: ‘The one who dishonors his father or mother is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.17: ‘The one who moves his neighbor’s boundary marker is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.18: ‘The one who leads a blind person astray on the road is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.19: ‘The one who denies justice to a resident alien, a fatherless child, or a widow is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.20: ‘The one who sleeps with his father’s wife is cursed, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ [1] And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.21: ‘The one who has sexual intercourse with any animal is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.22: ‘The one who sleeps with his sister, whether his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.23: ‘The one who sleeps with his mother-in-law is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.24: ‘The one who secretly kills his neighbor is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.25: ‘The one who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’
CSB17.26: ‘Anyone who does not put the words of this law into practice is cursed.’ And all the people will say, ‘Amen!’

WEB.1: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
WEB.2: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
WEB.3: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over; that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
WEB.4: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
WEB.5: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
WEB.6: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.
WEB.7: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.
WEB.8: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
WEB.9: Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silence, and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.
WEB.10: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
WEB.11: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
WEB.12: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
WEB.13: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
WEB.14: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
WEB.15: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
WEB.16: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

AMP.1: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, "Keep (remember, obey) all the commandments which I am commanding you today.
AMP.2: So it shall be on the day when you cross the Jordan to [enter] the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set up for yourself large stones and coat them with plaster (lime, whitewash).
AMP.3: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law when you cross over, so that you may go into the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land [of plenty] flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers has promised you.
AMP.4: Now when you cross the Jordan you shall set up these stones on Mount Ebal, just as I am commanding you today and coat them with plaster.
AMP.5: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones; you shall not use an iron tool on them.
AMP.6: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with whole [uncut] stones, and offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God;
AMP.7: and you shall sacrifice peace offerings and shall eat there, and shall rejoice before the LORD your God.
AMP.8: And you shall write very clearly on the stones all the words of this law."
AMP.9: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, "Be silent and listen, O Israel! This day you have become a people for the LORD your God.
AMP.10: So you shall obey the voice of the LORD your God, and do His commandments and statutes which I am commanding you today."
AMP.11: Moses also commanded the people that day, saying,
AMP.12: "These [tribes] shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people when you have crossed the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
AMP.13: These [tribes] shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce the curse [for disobedience]: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
AMP.14: The Levites shall answer with a loud voice to all the men of Israel:
AMP.15: 'Cursed is the man who makes a carved or cast image (idol), a repulsive thing to the LORD, the work of the hands of the artisan, and sets it up in secret.' All the people shall answer and say, 'Amen.'
AMP.16: 'Cursed is he who dishonors (treats with contempt) his father or his mother.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.17: 'Cursed is he who moves his neighbor's boundary mark.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.18: 'Cursed is he who misleads a blind person on the road.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.19: 'Cursed is he who distorts (perverts) the justice due to a stranger, an orphan, and a widow.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.20: 'Cursed is he who is intimate with his father's [former] wife, because he has violated what belongs to his father.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.21: 'Cursed is he who is intimate with any animal.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.22: 'Cursed is he who is intimate with his [half] sister, whether his father's or his mother's daughter.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.23: 'Cursed is he who is intimate with his mother-in-law.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.24: 'Cursed is he who strikes his neighbor in secret.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.25: 'Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to strike down an innocent person.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
AMP.26: 'Cursed is he who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them [keeping them, taking them to heart as the rule of his life].' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
